name: M3_OIS014MI_Get
description: Retrieve the field selection and default settings defined for a specific customer order type. The response exposes how customer order header and line fields are configured for that type, including payer and invoice recipient, warehouse and logistics parameters, pricing and discount controls, tax and trade agreement settings, statistical and commission parameters, and user‑defined header/line fields. This gives a complete, read‑only view of how the order type behaves when entering and processing customer orders in M3.
